# One smoke puff (a jittered icosphere, r 0.32 at full size) on a seamless 6 s rising loop, lit by the sun,
# with two emissive caps on its underside that catch the fire's light: Glow (terracotta, its lower
# half below z 0.1 r, radius 1.12 r) and Hot (tan, below z -0.35 r, radius 1.2 r). A cap is ON when it is out of
# the puff (scale 1) and OFF shrunk inside it (0.82 / 0.78). Per frame, brightness B = I[frame mod 12] + 1 -
# fade(height) (fade 0 low, 1, 2, 3 out of reach): Glow on when B >= 1, Hot when B >= 2, so the lowest
# puffs glow on every frame and flare tan with the flames, the middle ones only on the fire's flares,
# the top ones never. Frame 0 is t 0.75 (full size, caps off). Keys on every frame (constant).
# Generated by make_campfire.py. Up Z; origin = the birth point, the fire's centre on the ground.
new
fps 12
frame range 0 72
material new Smoke --base-color 0.5490 0.4863 0.4745 --no-slot
material new Glow --base-color 0.7255 0.4784 0.3765 --emission 0.7255 0.4784 0.3765 --no-slot
material new Hot --base-color 0.8000 0.6588 0.4824 --emission 0.8000 0.6588 0.4824 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.32 --location 0 0 0
material assign Smoke
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.04 --seed 6
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Glow --subdivisions 3 --radius 0.3584 --location 0 0 0
material assign Glow
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.0320"
delete vert
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Hot --subdivisions 3 --radius 0.3840 --location 0 0 0
material assign Hot
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > -0.1120"
delete vert
mode object
select Glow Hot Puff
active Puff
parent set Puff
select Puff
frame set 0
set location -0.2625 -0.0063 2.3500
set scale 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale
